parts.text: Which product categories had the longest average shipping delay (shipped to delivered) in the last 90 days?

In the last 90 days, the product category with the longest average shipping delay (shipped to delivered) is 'Clothing Sets' with an average delay of 3.1664 days. Note that the data for 'Clothing Sets', 'Jumpsuits & Rompers', and 'Suits' is of low confidence.

response.sql:
SELECT p.category AS name,
      ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.delivered_at, oi.shipped_at, SECOND))/86400, 4) AS value,
      COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM `enterprise-agent-labs-1012.thelook_golden.order_items` oi
    JOIN `enterprise-agent-labs-1012.thelook_golden.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    WHERE oi.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
      AND oi.delivered_at >= TIMESTAMP(@start) AND oi.delivered_at < TIMESTAMP(@end)
    GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC
